parent_namespace_point.qualification: Attributed root read-only point, not independently live-observed here. Outer must freshly recheck parents, both namespace strings and original caller identity under lock; point absence is not reservation or permission to precreate runtime/evidence.

request_contract.coordination_final_requirement: Exactly sole_build_owner=/root, agents_quiescent=true and no_ci=true as genuine launch conditions; true cannot be asserted while agents/tools remain active.
request_contract.directory_value_comparison: Outer same_dir compares only dev/ino/uid/mode, not nlink; metadata_directory must have exactly those four keys. All ancestry root-owned, non-group/other-writable, no symlink traversal under outer guard.

excludes_branches.EXCLUDE_ABSENT: info_directory exact five-field dev/ino/uid/mode/nlink pin, store/info exists and store/info/exclude absent; no exclude image.
excludes_branches.FILE: Same five-field info_directory pin, exact <=65536-byte exclude image included in request.images; state/pin/content all freshly reviewed.
excludes_branches.INFO_ABSENT: info_directory=null and original store/info absent; no exclude image.

git_inventory_binding.index_requirement: Fresh ordinary full stage0 index exactly matches all 3432 SOURCE path/mode/blob members, no split/sparse/unmerged index; genuine original index <=4MiB, not reconstructed/fake. Request index_sha256 equals images[publication index].sha256.
git_inventory_binding.metadata_requirement: Same reviewed metadata_directory as request parent for publication .git; no commondir/config.worktree/objects/info/alternates/objects/info/http-alternates. Bounded negative guards do not replace independent semantic review.
git_inventory_binding.reviewed_assertions_final_requirement: Exact six keys, each literal true only after genuine independent full-index/config/store/excludes/no-external-mechanism/freeze review; source guards are not a semantic parser.

images.conditional_rule: Include exactly if EXCLUDE_STATE=FILE (16 images); omit for INFO_ABSENT/EXCLUDE_ABSENT (15).
images.final_source_images: SOURCE/init known SHA256 values persist but need fresh final pins. Current inner/outer hashes are intermediate only; capture final bytes/pins after permitted literal edits.
images.pin_requirements: Observed stable regular root-owned single-link, no group/other write; all integer pin values include file type in mode and nanosecond timestamps; pin.bytes is file size, not a top-level image key.
images.python3_alias_case: Only /usr/bin/python3 may be captured as an image alias: exact literal readlink python3.12, target /usr/bin/python3.12; sha256/pin describe target and extra link_pin (eight fields)/link_target describe alias. If ordinary regular input, no invented link fields.

request_contract.packet_limits: Actual request <=1MiB; duplicate keys and nonfinite JSON refused. Root freezes actual bytes and file pin; no actual packet written here.

tool_aliases.requirement: Fresh exact alias lstat; uid0/nlink1. Given fixed paths Git is regular with readlink=null and lstat==Git image pin. Ruby is a direct reviewed symlink to ruby3.2 (relative or absolute, no .. or chained fallback); target image is separate. Do not guess actual alias text or any pin.

reviewer_owned_approval_contract.qualification: Genuine independent reviewer decision after final request/control/instance evidence review. No approval has been supplied or generated by this map; <=65536-byte actual approval is separately captured/rechecked under original lock.
reviewer_owned_approval_contract.request_sha256: SHA256 of actual final frozen request bytes, not canonicalized separately or calculated from this map.
reviewer_owned_approval_contract.sources_values: Final four SHA256 strings equal corresponding actual request.images[path].sha256.

scope.method: Bounded raw-source text, JSON and SHA256 reads only; no helper import, AST, compilation, execution, control tests, Git, live metadata/tool/process/runtime probes or analyzer execution. Own new report files only.
